problems_identified: Outdated homepage with low-quality hero image
No clear online ordering CTA above the fold
Poor mobile experience — menu required PDF download
Weak local SEO: no schema markup, thin meta description
Generic typography and no visual storytelling
No brand narrative or About section
outcome: Full redesign delivered. New site features cinematic hero, clear ordering flow, mobile-first menu, and local SEO implementation.
why_selected: Strong food brand with a loyal local following; website was a significant liability that undersold what the restaurant actually offers. High commercial potential: willing and able to pay for quality, 620+ engaged reviews, clear physical presence.
